deployment.supportedTarget: Node 24 standalone Next.js build. One app process, with SQLite and object storage on one persistent volume. Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml in the repository root; docs/platform/DEPLOYMENT.md is the runbook.
deployment.startupValidation: src/instrumentation.ts validates the environment before the server accepts a request and refuses to start on a missing or invalid setting, naming each variable and how to fix it.
deployment.healthChecks: GET /api/health is liveness (process only, so a database blip does not cause a restart loop). GET /api/ready checks configuration, database and object store separately and returns 503 with the failing check named.
deployment.verification: CI job 'deployment artifact' builds the standalone artifact that actually ships, starts it, and runs scripts/smoke-deployment.mjs: liveness, readiness, session, project create, artwork upload, project reopen and a real 3D preview render verified by pixel variance rather than element presence.
deployment.scaledMode: UNSUPPORTED. Rate limits and background job runners are process-local and SQLite is the only runnable adapter, so a second instance would diverge rather than scale. VORTEX_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=scaled fails closed at startup. Tracked by issue #25.

cloudflareWorkers.commands: npm run experimental:cloudflare-build / experimental:cloudflare-preview. Deliberately not named 'deploy'.
cloudflareWorkers.deployResult: REJECTED_BY_CLOUDFLARE_API code 10027: Worker exceeded the 3 MiB free-plan script limit
cloudflareWorkers.architecturalBlocker: The server bundle embeds better-sqlite3 and sharp, which are native modules that cannot execute on Workers at any bundle size. A larger plan limit does not address this. A viable Workers target needs SQLite replaced with D1 or Hyperdrive and sharp-based image work moved off the Worker; until then this path is experimental and unsupported.
cloudflareWorkers.note: Cloudflare credentials WERE available and authenticated; this is not a credential blocker.
